title: Chapter 660
paragraphs: Chapter 660
Episode 167. The Fifth Tomb of Temer (4)
Whoosh-!
Black blood, drenched in chaos, splattered on their faces.
Luntia, who had been relentlessly swinging her sword even as her body shattered into pieces, finally stopped moving.
"Gurgh..."
Brief glimpses of the connection points, severed like threads, were visible behind Luntia.
The connection points tried to converge back to Luntia, but they were obstructed by the trail left by the King of Netherworld's Sword.
Particles of chaos fell like black rain between the fissures of the dimensional space.
He had stabbed the brother with whom he shared a bond.
Even though the situation demanded it, something felt painfully broken inside his heart.
"I... lost."
A grating sound came from Luntia's hoarse throat.
Jin did not twist the sword he had plunged into her chest.
If possible, he wanted to have a final conversation with his sister.
If Luntia, facing death, could shake off her madness, even slightly.
"Sister Luntia."
"Hoo."
"Are you a bit more aware now?"
"Little one..."
Jin's eyes widened.
Luntia's sanity was returning.
Slowly, Luntia gripped the blade of Bradamante.
Her eyes, alternating between looking at the blade and Jin, were not immersed in chaotic blackness.
Overwhelmed by the sudden rush of shocking emotions, Luntia closed her eyes tightly once.
"I have been too cruel to you..."
With her remaining strength, she started to push the blade out of her body.
It was not an act of retaliation.
Jin cautiously helped her to extract the sword from her body.
Chunks of hardened flesh dropped whenever she moved or exerted strength.
As soon as the sword was drawn out, Luntia took a slow, deep breath.
Jin was unable to choose what to say to her.
"Your act of stabbing me was an inevitable choice."
Jin had only once seen a human, completely corroded by chaos, regain their sanity.
It was when Ron Hairan entered Genesis, but it seemed that Luntia's regaining of sanity was for a different reason.
She hadn't achieved Genesis like Ron.
"There wouldn't have been a better option than this. If it wasn't for you, I would have had to endure meaningless time dominated by this dark space and chaos."
"How did... it come to this?"
At his words, Luntia responded with a bitter smile.
"It's because of family."
Family.
The family she was referring to was unlikely to be Rosana and her other brothers.
If the Runcandels used the term family as if talking about something very precious, it usually referred to people other than kin.

It could be a nanny who played the role of a real parent more than the biological parents, colleagues formed during the growth process, a person who gave their heart, or in very special cases, close siblings.
So Jin could immediately think of a person's name.
"...Nanny Risham. Did Rosana and the Prophet take Risham hostage?"
Risham, she is the nanny of Luntia Runcandel.
Jin had asked Luntia before the battle began if she had been blackmailed, with Risham in mind from the start.
Luntia nodded.
"My nanny asked me a favor."
"Nanny Risham asked you to accept the chaos...?"
The nannies of the Runcandels Jin had seen so far were devoted to a brutal degree.
There is no personal life for the nannies.
They existed purely for the children they were in charge of and did not harm them under any circumstances.
Taimun Marius, who had deceived Luna, eventually became Joshua's dog, but his essence was twisted love for Luna.
Of course, Gillie, and even Taimun, would not have asked their child to accept chaos.
As far as Jin knew, Risham was also that kind of person.
She could pay any price, even death or something harsher, for Luntia.
"Was Nanny Risham already brainwashed?"
"No, my nanny was fine. Just..."
Luntia's eyes turned red.
"She had a daughter."
"Nanny Risham has a daughter."
Runcandel's nannies cannot have children.
Even the foster children that Taimun cultivated from the orphanage were just disposable weapons.
If they had been Taimun's biological children, the Runcandel would not have chosen Taimun as a nanny.
But Risham has a biological child.
Even without hearing it, Jin seemed to know the unpleasant circumstances that would follow.
"When I was in the storm castle, my nanny was absent for about a year. She said she gave birth to a daughter during that time..."
Risham was in danger of paying a cruel price for breaking the nanny's laws.
From her newly born child to her tribe and the relatives of the tribe, they were all nearly exterminated.
However, Risham did not pay any price.
"Back then, my father personally covered up the matter."
At that time, Chiron covered up Risham's sin with a single word and saved her child and tribe.
It was the first time in Chiron's era that a nanny broke the family's law and he covered it up.
Instead, Risham never saw her daughter and tribe again after giving birth, and they were all expelled from Huphester and moved to a small city in the Lutero Magical Federation.
"...I suppose the reason the head of the family forgave me at the time was probably because of you, Miss."
"Because of me?"
"You cherished me a lot when you were young. Of course, you still do."
"My father would have thought that such a gesture on my part showed a lack of will and fighting spirit. So there's no way he would have saved my nanny and her offspring."

"But here I am, alive, Miss. And while I'm old and don't have many days left...my daughter, whom I haven't seen since that day, is said to be living an ordinary life with her own family. A normal and happy life."

"Rosana is going to kill them all now. Since it was an issue that the head of the family had personally squashed, even Rosana didn't know where those children were living...but I heard that Ilina found them."
"What? Get up, nanny. Why are you doing this?"
"I have devoted my entire life to you. I've given up my youth and my entire life. So just once...can't you show mercy to this wretched person just once?"
"I'll try to stop my mother. Get up, don't do this!"
"That alone won't save my daughter and grandchildren..."
The condition offered by Rosana was for Luntia to 'replace' the owner of this subspace.
To replace the original owner of this subspace.
Luntia accepted this condition.
As Luntia explained these details, Jin's head was throbbing with the effort to control the hatred for Rosana rising in his heart.

"It's said to be a year. Just for one year, I was to replace the entity that was originally the owner of this subspace. The ancient knight Padler Runcandel, he was originally the owner of this place."
I anticipated that the prophet would resurrect Padler from the grave, but I never thought that Luntia would end up replacing her.
In the first place, I didn't even know that such a thing was possible.
"This damn..."

"But as soon as I replaced Sir Padler through Illyna's ability, I realized that it was a lie. Even after a hundred years, I wouldn't be able to escape from this place. The prophet might have another way that I don't know, but I was certain. I had become completely one with the subspace."
That was why Luntia was able to regain her sanity even though she was consumed by chaos.
She was no longer the human Luntia Runcandel, she had become the subspace itself.
Therefore, as the energy of the subspace was exhausted, the chaos that devoured her also faded.
That also meant that the moment the subspace collapses, Luntia will also meet her death.
Even now, the subspace was breaking down in real-time, dropping black rain of chaos.
Jin's eyes landed on the connecting points.
"If you reconnect those to sister, can you survive?"

"That would be the case, since the whole subspace isn't completely destroyed yet. But I don't really want that, youngest brother. It seems better to end it this way. At least my sanity has returned and I can die as myself."
"How did you enter here, sister? From my point of view, the prophet might be able to make you a replacement for Sir Padler, but he doesn't know the way back here."
"That's possible. But does that matter? After all, the goal was probably to use Sir Padler, who was here in my place, at full power."

"I know one sure way to get in here. If you're alive, sister, when I can save you, I can come back. Although it's impossible to cure complete erosion or cases like you, there's a way to purify the chaos."
"If I reconnect to that, I'll go mad again."

"I don't want to lose you like this, sister. Just hang in there, and I'll definitely make purification possible. If you disappear like this, sister, we can't get revenge on them. And there's no guarantee that they've spared Nurse Risham's daughter."

"That's right, there's no guarantee. Only mother's promise. If Nurse had told me before her family was taken hostage, I might have looked for another way. But at that time, there was no other way. I couldn't turn my back on the nurse, I couldn't."
"I wouldn't have been able to turn my back on Gilly either. I'll check and protect Nurse Risham's family, so please wait."
Luntia hesitated for a moment and then nodded.
"Okay. I'm already trapped and floundering... But why are you going this far for me? You could just kill me here, it wouldn't be that bad for you."
"Then wouldn't we become better family, you and me?"
Jin grabbed the connection points.
"Jin, when I regain the power of the subspace now..."
"I'll connect after finding Hister. If you have the energy to move, please help. You said Hister is hiding somewhere in this subspace."
"Go ahead."
